text:
Sam Blake: Quick kickoff for a marketplace intake. Scope: AWS/GCP/Azure initial listing, EULA + logo release, AMI/OVA + GCP image (x86 & arm64), Azure managed image id, pricing SKUs, trial entitlements, and a short SI note for our partner 'CloudFound'. Who can own which pieces?

Priya Singh: I can take legal artifacts (EULA + trademark release) and the SI language. Need marketing-signed logo and incident contact. Also confirm we use "listed with CloudFound" not "joint offering".

Evan Cho: Ill handle images: AMIs for us-west-2 & eu-west-1, GCP images, and an OVA for the appliance SKU. Will include cloud-init to write /etc/marketplace-validate and a health endpoint. Need the staging publisher IDs and any acceptance test token.

Marta Ruiz: Ill do packaging/hero assets + screenshots. Marketing will provide co-branded hero if CloudFound ok. ETA assets Wed.

Sam Blake: Publisher refs (staging): AWS 666777888999, GCP project redwood-market-stg-3, Azure publisher redwood-csp-prep. Evan, will DM infra for the validation token and test checklist. Recommended AMI name: redwood-inference-ami-ubuntu22-<region>-<arch>-2026-07.

Evan Cho: Copy. Ill build x86 + arm64 AMIs and include `/usr/local/bin/market-validate.sh` that writes the token and runs `curl -fsS http://localhost:8080/health`. ETA: AMIs Tue EOD, GCP Wed. Will post IDs + SHA256.

Priya Singh: SI wording draft: "Redwood Inference is listed with CloudFound for deployment and managed services. Customers engaging CloudFound will coordinate appliance installs and infra support with CloudFound; Redwood provides product support." OK to post?

Marta Ruiz: That reads fine. Please include contact: partner@cloudfound.example and add a short line about co-branding approval.

Sam Blake: Marketplace bot, can you open an intake ticket and attach a checklist template?

MarketplaceBot: Ticket MP-7122 created: "marketplace intake - redwood inference (CloudFound)" assigned partnerships. https://tickets.redwood.example/MP-7122

Evan Cho: Also noting Azure requires a managed image resource id in the portal. Ill ask infra to publish one in the staging subscription and share the resource id.

Priya Singh: Trial policy: product suggests 30-day trial with 50k token cap and 10 rps. Legal needs the exact quota lines for EULA appendix and trial terms. Also add KMS line: "Customer-managed keys supported for Dedicated and Private; hosted uses Redwood-managed keys by default."

Marta Ruiz: Marketing will supply hero images + signed logo release by Wed EOD. Ill upload assets to MP-7122.

Sam Blake: Actions: Evan = images + validation artifacts (post IDs/checksums), Priya = EULA + SI language + trial terms, Marta = hero assets + co-brand clearance, Sam = finalize SKU/pricing rows and submit intake. Target: portal submission by next Fri COB.

Evan Cho: + posting AMI and image IDs here once live.

Priya Singh: + will upload EULA after marketing signs.

Marta Ruiz: + will confirm CloudFound logo approval.

Sam Blake: Thanks all. If anything blocks, ping me or escalate to partnerships channel.
